# Spark UI (@sparkwire)

> React component library with a "Live Wire" look: components carry current (sparks on press, flowing current on hover, a lever switch with a bulb). Accessible behaviour from React Aria, zero-runtime CSS with --spark-* variables, light/dark/system modes, works in React Server Components. Use it as an npm package (@sparkwire/core) or copy the source (npx sparkwire add <name>).

Key facts for writing code:
- Import the stylesheet once: import '@sparkwire/core/styles.css'. Set the mode with data-spark-theme="dark" | "light" | "system" on <html> or any wrapper.
- App-wide defaults and slot classes: <SparkProvider components={{ Button: { defaultProps: { variant: 'outlined' } } }} locale="hi-IN">.
- Every component takes className, and most take classNames for inner parts. State is exposed as data-* attributes (data-state, data-open, data-invalid, data-disabled) for CSS or Tailwind.
- Forms: inputs take name and work with FormData and React Hook Form. Dropdown/Combobox/Slider/DatePicker submit through hidden inputs.
- Dates are plain JS Date objects; DatePicker submits ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Locales and calendar systems (indian, islamic-umalqura, buddhist...) are supported.
- Pick a value: Dropdown (alias Select). Search then pick: Combobox. Run actions: Menu.
- Custom markup with Spark behaviour: useSwitch, useCheckbox, useSlider, useDatePicker, useSpark from '@sparkwire/core/headless'. Building blocks: ButtonBase, InputBase, Popover, ListBox, Overlay from '@sparkwire/core/base'.
- The npm scope is @sparkwire (not @spark-ui, which is a different library).

## Components
- [Button](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/button): Throws sparks from the press point; current runs along outlined buttons on hover. Exports: Button.
- [Spark](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/spark): A burst of sparks from a point; used by Button and Calendar. Exports: Spark.
- [Switch](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/switch): A lever switch that lights a bulb. Exports: Switch.
- [Checkbox](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/checkbox): A checkbox that closes a circuit. Exports: Checkbox.
- [RadioGroup](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/radio-group): One live wire at a time. Exports: RadioGroup.
- [Slider](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/slider): A dimmer, with two-knob ranges. Exports: Slider.
- [Textfield](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/textfield): A field that charges as you type. Exports: Textfield.
- [Field](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/field): Label, help text and error wiring for any control. Exports: Field.
- [NumberField](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/number-field): Locale-formatted numbers (₹1,00,000, %, units) with steppers. Exports: NumberField.
- [ToggleGroup](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/toggle-group): Segmented control or a row of independent toggles, with arrow-key navigation. Exports: ToggleGroup, ToggleGroup.Item, ToggleGroupItem.
- [Stepper](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/stepper): Progress through a multi-step flow; clickable steps, errors, vertical, compact on small screens. Exports: Stepper.
- [FileUpload](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/file-upload): Drop zone and file list with type/size/count checks, thumbnails, progress and errors. Exports: FileUpload.
- [TimePicker](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/time-picker): Type a time segment by segment or pick from suggestions every N minutes; min/max and blocked slots. Exports: TimePicker.
- [Textarea](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/textarea): Multi-line text that grows with its content, with a character count. Exports: Textarea.
- [Alert](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/alert): Info, success, warning and error messages, with actions, dismiss and a banner variant. Exports: Alert.
- [Navigation](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/breadcrumbs): Breadcrumbs and Pagination. Exports: Breadcrumbs, Pagination.
- [Charts](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/line-chart): Our own SVG charts: Line/Area, Bar (grouped, stacked, horizontal), Donut, Sparkline. Validated colour-blind-safe palette, tooltips, keyboard, data-table view. Exports: LineChart, BarChart, DonutChart, Sparkline.
- [Dropdown](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/dropdown): Pick one value from a list. Exports: Dropdown.
- [Combobox](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/combobox): Type to search, then pick. Exports: Combobox.
- [DatePicker](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/date-picker): DatePicker, DateRangePicker, Calendar and RangeCalendar: typed entry, presets, date rules, locales and calendar systems. Exports: DatePicker, Segment, DateRangePicker, Calendar, RangeCalendar.
- [DataTable](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/data-table): Sort, search, filter, page and select rows; responsive div grid, no table library. Exports: DataTable.
- [CommandPalette](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/command-palette): A ⌘K launcher: search commands and pages, run with the keyboard. Exports: CommandPalette.
- [Menu](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/menu): Actions behind a button, with submenus. Exports: Menu.
- [Sidebar](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/sidebar): App navigation: sections, nested groups, collapsed rail, drawer on small screens. Exports: Sidebar.
- [Tabs](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/tabs): Tabs on one wire; the active tab is lit. Exports: Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel.
- [Accordion](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/accordion): Sections that power on as they open. Exports: Accordion, AccordionItem.
- [Modal](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/modal): A dialog that powers on, with focus trapping. Exports: Modal.
- [Drawer](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/drawer): A panel that slides in from an edge, with focus trapping. Exports: Drawer.
- [Tooltip](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/tooltip): A hint that flickers on. Exports: Tooltip.
- [Toast](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/toast): Notifications. Exports: ToastProvider, ToastShowOptions.
- [Card](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/card): Card, CardHeader, CardFooter and Skeleton. Exports: Card, CardHeader, CardFooter, Skeleton.
- [Avatar](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/avatar): Avatar and AvatarGroup. Exports: Avatar, AvatarGroup.
- [Indicators](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/badge): Badge, Progress and Spinner. Exports: Badge, Progress, Spinner.
- [SparkProvider](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/provider): App-wide default props, slot classes and locale. Exports: SparkProvider.
- [Base components](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/components/base): ButtonBase, InputBase, Popover, ListBox and Overlay: the building blocks under the other components. Exports: ButtonBase, InputBase, Popover, ListItemContent, ListBox, Overlay.
